Three.js 0.180.0 (MIT)
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.180.0.tgz
Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three/tree/r180
three.module.min.js and three.core.min.js are unmodified official package builds.
CSS3DRenderer.js is the official addon; its bare 'three' import was replaced
with './three.module.min.js' for local, buildless ESM loading.
The original MIT license is included as LICENSE.
